decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot embodies the firm's publicly announced push toward automated precast production and required substantial in-house R&D, so management will defend the investment while only one year of results is in.

The automatic de-shuttering robot rests on heavy engineering investment and fits the visible automation strategy, so any early weakness can still be attributed to the slow construction market rather than the product.

The profile storage robot is a newly launched, visibly promoted component of the integrated robotic line, so dropping it after one year would write off development costs and undercut the firm's coordinated-solution message.

The automatic shuttering robot is core to the firm's future-ready automation direction and was publicly launched only recently, making continued commitment the likely choice despite possible soft demand.
